title: VacationResponse/set: failed patch on a fresh account destroys the singleton (panics with history)
description: vacation.rs:311 rollback of the upsert calls destroy_object::<VacationResponse>; memory/mod.rs:1795-1798 asserts the singleton is never destroyed -> panic on the next update with history on; without history a destroyed id is reused. Also VacationResponse/get on such an account returns list [] notFound []. RFC 8621 §8 exactly one VacationResponse. (probe-confirmed) (mail-server review 2026-11-19)
close_reason: Fixed with regression tests (tests/submission_envelope.rs, sieve_activate.rs, vacation_singleton.rs, mdn_integration.rs).
